operationAdded: ScenarioBuilder.occlude(observer, target, catalog_id, count) — agent declares only who is hidden from whom; station derived from the target, standoff and reveal time SOLVED.
mechanismFound: a TALL VEHICLE in the ADJACENT lane (laneOffset=-1, tFrac=0) genuinely occludes. The same object at tFrac=-1 of the ego lane NEVER does — tFrac is clamped to the lane edges so the verge is unreachable, and an occluder at the ego lane edge sits at the same lateral position as the VRU it is meant to hide.
conclusion: The occlusion MECHANISM is real and now declarable and measurable, but occlusion and criticality rarely co-occur under the current placement geometry. Solving for occlusion alone loses criticality; the joint objective finds almost nothing. C7 is NOT closed.
blocker: props.pose.tFrac clamped to [-1,1]. A roadside occluder (hedge, wall, parked row on the verge) is unrepresentable. The adjacent-lane workaround requires a multi-lane road, which is rare on these maps (throughLanesSameDir>=2 fails at 157/210 candidate sites), so it cannot generalise across sites.
nextStep: Add a lateral placement form for props that can reach the verge — e.g. lateral_m with reference:'lane_edge'|'verge' — in packages/scenario/src/schema/v2/roles.ts FramePoseSchema plus the materializer lateral resolution. That is the single change standing between this corpus and a proven C7.
